```{python}
#| include: false

import io
import re
from pathlib import Path

from _bem_monthly import format_fit, hac


def read_annual_factors(path, columns):
    rows = re.findall(r"^\s*([0-9]{4},[^\n]+)", Path(path).read_text(), flags=re.MULTILINE)
    return pl.read_csv(
        io.StringIO("\n".join(row.replace(" ", "") for row in rows)),
        has_header=False,
        new_columns=columns,
        schema_overrides={"Holding year": pl.Int32},
    )


ff3 = read_annual_factors("data/ff3-201607.csv", ["Holding year", "MKT", "SMB", "HML", "RF"])
momentum = read_annual_factors("data/momentum-202412.csv", ["Holding year", "MOM"])
factors = ff3.drop("RF").join(momentum, on="Holding year", validate="1:1")

factor_models = {
    "Excess return": [],
    "CAPM": ["MKT"],
    "FF": ["MKT", "SMB", "HML"],
    "FFC": ["MKT", "SMB", "HML", "MOM"],
}


def fit_portfolios(returns, columns, model="Excess return"):
    terms = factor_models[model]
    sample = returns.sort("year")
    if terms:
        sample = (
            sample.with_columns((pl.col("year") + 1).alias("Holding year"))
            .join(factors.select("Holding year", *terms), on="Holding year",
                  how="left", validate="1:1", maintain_order="left")
        )
    rhs = " + ".join(terms) or "1"
    return {
        column: hac(f"outcome ~ {rhs}", sample.select(pl.col(column).alias("outcome"), *terms))
        for column in columns
    }


def show_holding_year(returns):
    show_table(
        returns.select(pl.col("year").alias("Formation year"),
                       (pl.col("year") + 1).alias("Holding year"), pl.exclude("year"))
    )


def target_label(variable, group):
    return f"{variable} " + {5: "4–1", 6: "average"}.get(group, str(group))


def show_grid(cells, control, target, *, holding=False):
    headings = {column: f"{control} {column}" for column in control_ports}
    headings.update({"Diff": f"{control} 3–1", "Avg": f"{control} average"})
    table = cells.with_columns(
        pl.col("target").replace_strict(
            {group: target_label(target, group) for group in range(1, 7)}
        )
    ).rename({"target": "Portfolio", **{c: h for c, h in headings.items() if c in cells.columns}})
    if holding:
        show_holding_year(table)
    else:
        show_table(table.rename({"year": "Year"}) if "year" in table.columns else table)


def grid_fits(returns):
    columns = [*control_ports, "Diff", "Avg"]
    return {
        (group, model): fit_portfolios(returns.filter(pl.col("target") == group), columns, model)
        for group in sorted(returns["target"].unique())
        for model in ["Excess return", "FFC"]
    }


def show_grid_fits(fits, *, dependent=False):
    columns = [*control_ports, "Avg"] if dependent else [*control_ports, "Diff", "Avg"]
    headers = [f"Beta {column}" for column in columns]
    rows = [
        [target_label("MktCap", group), label,
         *[format_fit(fits[group, model][column], "Intercept") for column in columns]]
        for group in range(1, 6 if dependent else 7)
        for model, label in [("Excess return", "Excess return"), ("FFC", "FFC alpha")]
    ]
    show_table(pl.DataFrame(rows, schema=["Portfolio", "Statistic", *headers], orient="row"))


def show_spreads(results, label):
    columns = [*control_ports, "Avg", "Diff"]
    rows = [
        [variable, statistic, *[format_fit(fits[5, model][column], "Intercept") for column in columns]]
        for variable, fits in results.items()
        for model, statistic in [("Excess return", "Excess return"), ("FFC", "FFC alpha")]
    ]
    show_table(pl.DataFrame(
        rows, schema=[label, "Statistic", "1", "2", "3", "Average", "3–1"], orient="row"
    ))


def show_average_portfolios(results, label):
    rows = [
        [variable, statistic,
         *[format_fit(fits[group, model]["Avg"], "Intercept") for group in range(1, 6)]]
        for variable, fits in results.items()
        for model, statistic in [("Excess return", "Excess return"), ("FFC", "FFC alpha")]
    ]
    show_table(pl.DataFrame(rows, schema=[label, "Statistic", "1", "2", "3", "4", "4–1"], orient="row"))
```
